pharmacology.text: Itameline (INN; developmental code name RU-47213) is a non-selective muscarinic acetylcholine receptor agonist nootropic drug which was under development for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease and memory disorders but was never marketed. Itameline is a prodrug of an arecoline derivative. It is an agonist of the muscarinic acetylcholine M1 receptor as well as of other muscarinic acetylcholine receptors.

uses.text: Itameline (INN; developmental code name RU-47213) is a non-selective muscarinic acetylcholine receptor agonist nootropic drug which was under development for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease and memory disorders but was never marketed. It was under development by Hoechst Marion Roussel and reached phase 2 clinical trials by 1998 prior to discontinuation of development.
